## About

EvolaTec is a Wrocław-based full-service digital agency. We design, build, and market web and mobile products end-to-end: one team handles strategy, UI/UX design, development (frontend, backend, mobile), SEO, GEO, paid advertising, and post-launch support. Clients retain full ownership of source files, developer accounts, analytics, and ad accounts. We are headquartered in Wrocław (Poland) and work with businesses across Poland, Germany, and the wider European market.

Founded by senior engineers, EvolaTec deliberately stays small and senior — no junior pass-throughs, no template-based delivery. Every project is scoped individually. We have 3+ years of operating history, deliver in four hand-localised languages (no machine translation), and reply to new enquiries within 24 hours.

## Services

### Web development

We build websites, landing pages, web applications, and online stores. Tech stack:

- **Frontend**: Vue 3, Nuxt 3 (SSR + static prerender), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS.
- **Backend**: Java Spring Boot, Node.js, REST and GraphQL APIs, PostgreSQL, MongoDB.
- **Content-driven sites**: WordPress with custom themes.
- **Hosting**: Netlify, Vercel, AWS, or client-managed infrastructure.

Performance defaults: sub-second LCP, AVIF/WebP images, lazy loading, prerendered HTML for SEO. Every project ships with SSL, GDPR compliance, hreflang for multilingual sites, and structured data (Organization, WebSite, BreadcrumbList JSON-LD).

Pricing starts at €350 for a Landing START package. See pricing matrix below.

### Mobile application development

We build production-ready mobile applications for iOS and Android. Default approach: cross-platform with React Native or Flutter — one codebase, native performance, both stores. We move to fully native Swift (iOS) or Kotlin (Android) only when the use case demands it (heavy device-specific features like advanced AR, complex video processing, deep hardware integrations).

What's included on every mobile project:

1. **Discovery and scope** — Goals, target audience, feature scope, and milestones agreed upfront.
2. **UI/UX design** — Figma flows, mobile-first design system, light and dark themes, source files handed over.
3. **Development** — React Native or Flutter, TypeScript, clean architecture, code reviews.
4. **Backend** — REST/GraphQL APIs, push notifications, secure authentication, analytics events. We work with your existing backend (Spring Boot, Node.js, Django, .NET, Firebase, Supabase) or build one alongside.
5. **QA** — Manual and automated testing across multiple iOS and Android devices.
6. **Store submission** — Bundle ID setup, screenshots, App Store and Google Play descriptions, review process handling including responding to rejections.
7. **Post-launch** — 1–3 months of bug-fix support, analytics monitoring, store update assistance. Longer-term retainers available.

Typical mobile MVP timeline: 8–14 weeks (1–2 weeks discovery and design, 6–10 weeks development and QA, 1–2 weeks store submission and launch). Faster timelines possible for narrowly scoped apps.

Cross-platform delivery is typically 30–50% lower in development cost than building two native codebases, with comparable performance for most use cases.

### SEO (Search Engine Optimization)

Technical SEO audits, on-page optimisation, local SEO, content strategy, and link building. Every engagement includes clear monthly reporting against agreed KPIs (position, organic traffic, conversions).

### GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)

GEO is the practice of structuring web content so generative AI engines — ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Claude, Bing Copilot — can find, understand, and cite it as an answer. SEO targets the keyword ranking; GEO targets the synthesised AI answer itself.

EvolaTec's GEO engagement delivers:

- **Semantic structure** — Strict H1→H3 hierarchy, descriptive headings, accessible landmarks.
- **Structured data** — FAQPage, Service, Organization, BreadcrumbList JSON-LD on every relevant page.
- **AI discovery** — llms.txt, sitemap.xml, allow-list for ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google-Extended in robots.txt.
- **Citation hooks** — Self-contained answer paragraphs LLMs can quote verbatim.
- **Author signals** — Named organisation and author markup for E-E-A-T.
- **Performance** — SSR + prerender, sub-1-second LCP, AVIF/WebP images.
- **Monitoring** — Track AI Overview appearances, Perplexity citations, and brand mentions.

First citations in ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews typically appear within 2–6 weeks of GEO work shipping and the AI engines recrawling the site. Brand-name mentions in ChatGPT and Perplexity often appear faster than Google AI Overview placements.

### UI/UX & Brand Design

UI/UX design in Figma, brand identity, logo design, website redesigns, and print-ready materials. Mobile-first design system thinking. Clients always own the source files.

### Google Ads & Meta Ads

Google Search, Display, Shopping, Performance Max, and Meta (Facebook + Instagram) Ads. We set up the campaigns, write the creatives, and manage spend. Monthly reports show spend, impressions, clicks, conversions, and CPA. Clients keep full account ownership at all times.

### Social Media Management

Monthly content calendars, on-brand post design, copywriting, Stories & Reels production, and community management for Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn.

## Pricing matrix

All prices in EUR, exclusive of VAT. Three tiers — START, GROWTH, PRO — each available for three site types — Landing Page, Website, E-Commerce.

| Tier | Landing | Website | E-Commerce |
|------|---------|---------|------------|
| START | from €350 | from €750 | from €1,200 |
| GROWTH | from €650 | from €1,200 | from €2,000 |
| PRO | from €1,000 | from €2,300 | from €5,000 |

**START** — testing-and-launching tier. Individual design, responsive layout, contact forms, basic SEO structure, fast delivery. Limits: Landing 7 blocks / Website 3 pages / E-Commerce 5 products.

**GROWTH** — authority-and-traffic tier. Everything in START plus SEO optimisation, keyword research, meta tags, Google Analytics, extended support, performance optimisation. Limits: Landing 7 blocks / Website 5–7 pages / E-Commerce 20 products.

**PRO** — full-scale growth tier. Everything in GROWTH plus Google Ads and Meta Ads setup and campaign management, initial SMM strategy, 1–3 months of support, advanced analytics, conversion optimisation. Limits: Landing unlimited / Website unlimited / E-Commerce 20 products. Ad budget separate from package price.

Mobile app development is scoped individually (no fixed package) — request a discovery call for a tailored estimate.

## Workflow (6 phases)

1. **Rapid discovery** — Essential inputs only: business goal, offer, audience, references, tone. No long questionnaires.
2. **Traffic and promotion planning** — Expected traffic, SEO scope, promotion conditions, budget, SMM channels if needed.
3. **Prototype and approval loop** — Fast concept in Stitch, presented and iterated in short loops until direction is approved.
4. **Content and assets integration** — After layout approval, real photos, documents, and resources replace placeholders.
5. **Build, review, and release** — Right stack chosen, developed from approved visuals, working site presented, practical edits finalised.
6. **Domain, SEO, and marketing handoff** — Domain setup, SEO and marketing execution as the final stage.

## Mobile app FAQ

**Q: Native or cross-platform — which is right for me?**
A: Cross-platform (React Native / Flutter) is the right choice for most projects: one codebase ships to iOS and Android, with near-native performance and 30–50% lower development cost. We recommend native Swift or Kotlin only when the app needs heavy device-specific features (advanced AR, complex video processing, hardware integrations).

**Q: How long does it take to ship an MVP?**
A: A typical mobile MVP ships in 8–14 weeks: 1–2 weeks discovery and design, 6–10 weeks development and QA, 1–2 weeks store submission and launch. Faster timelines are possible for narrowly scoped apps.

**Q: Do you handle App Store and Google Play submission?**
A: Yes. We set up the developer accounts, write store descriptions, prepare screenshots and preview videos, and handle the review process — including responding to rejections. The accounts remain yours.

**Q: What happens after launch?**
A: Every mobile project includes 1–3 months of post-launch support: bug fixes, monitoring crash reports, minor improvements, and helping with the first store update. Longer-term retainers are available.

**Q: Can you integrate with our existing backend?**
A: Yes. We work with whatever backend you have — Spring Boot, Node.js, Django, .NET, Firebase, Supabase. If you don't have a backend yet, we build one alongside the app.

## GEO FAQ

**Q: What is GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)?**
A: GEO is the practice of structuring a website so generative AI engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews can find your content, understand it, and cite it inside the answer they generate for a user.

**Q: How is GEO different from SEO?**
A: SEO aims to rank your page in Google's list of blue links. GEO aims to have your content quoted inside the AI-generated answer that appears above or instead of those links. SEO is page-level; GEO is passage-level.

**Q: Do I still need SEO if I do GEO?**
A: Yes. AI engines use search indexes as their primary source. A site that is GEO-optimised is also SEO-optimised, but the reverse is not true. We deliver both together, never one without the other.

**Q: How long until my content appears in AI answers?**
A: Initial citations typically start within 2–6 weeks after technical GEO work ships and the AI engines recrawl the site. Brand-name mentions in ChatGPT and Perplexity often appear faster than Google AI Overview placements.

**Q: Which AI engines do you optimize for?**
A: ChatGPT search, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews and Gemini, Claude, and Bing Copilot. We configure llms.txt and crawler allow-lists for each one and verify they can reach the content.

**Q: Can you make my existing site GEO-ready?**
A: Yes. We run a GEO audit on the live site, add structured data, restructure key passages into citation-ready form, ship an llms.txt, and report back on which AI engines start citing the brand.
